title: Analysis code for: Decomposing the shift from hepatitis B to non-alcoholic fatty liver disease burden, GBD 2023, 1990-2023, with scenarios to 2035
description: Python code that reproduces every quantitative result in the manuscript: a four-component decomposition of the change in a two-cause burden share (hepatitis B versus NAFLD), approximate uncertainty intervals derived from GBD count intervals, and anchored scenarios to 2035. A script-to-result traceability table is included. Raw GBD exports are not redistributed; download parameters and the SHA-256 hashes of the three inputs used by the analysis and calibration scripts are given in the README.
